description.value: Laura Creek is a backcountry campsite within Cape Scott Park, a rugged coastal wilderness at the northwestern tip of Vancouver Island reached by a long gravel forest-service road and then a multi-kilometre hike through old-growth rainforest. This is a serious commitment — hike-in only, no services, reliably wet, and very remote.
